meta.title: Leonida Atlas v3 — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
meta.note: Every name and description below is the official PSN wording. Guides and steps are written for this atlas and cite the numbered sources inline.

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.role: Trophy guide and roadmap: difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, the Chapter 1 meditation warning and most per-trophy methods.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.role: The live PSN trophy list and player tracking used to cross-check names, grades and hidden status.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.role: The published PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies with the 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze split.

sources.name: PlayStationTrophies
sources.role: Independent guide coverage used to cross-check unlock conditions and cleanup order.

sources.name: TrueTrophies
sources.role: Trophy list mirror and rarity data used to confirm hidden trophies and totals.

sources.name: GTABase
sources.role: Locations, Gamerscore values and activity counts: vaults, gangs, races, ranges and collectible sets.

sources.name: GTA Wiki (Fandom)
sources.role: World reference for characters, counties, gangs and businesses named in the trophy text.

sources.name: Rockstar Newswire
sources.role: Official announcements: release timing, editions and post-launch notes from Rockstar itself.

sources.name: IGN Wiki
sources.role: Mechanics explainers for systems such as Combat Focus, the WAiNK app and the criminal profile.

sources.name: PlayStation
sources.role: Official store and platform pages: single-player listing, trophy system behaviour and PSN progress targets.

stages.name: Chapter 1 — Learn Leonida, guard the balcony
stages.focus: Story openers plus the one moment that may never come back: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house.
stages.detail: Play Gone Fishing, meet Cal and Kenton, try an arcade game at home, and accept the meditation when Lucia offers it in the morning after Down to Earth. Keep a manual save before Chapter 1 ends. [1]

stages.name: Chapters 2–3 — The duo unlocks
stages.focus: Free-roam together after Coffee Break, then build the money and vehicle systems: garages, Scooter Bros, Randy's list, Tyrone's labs and Yasmani's jewelry jobs.
stages.detail: Once Jason and Lucia can travel together, partner trophies open up. Chapter 3 adds the Key Cloner, the Dye Pack Jammer and the Snap Gun, which quietly unlock several later trophies. [1][6]

stages.name: Chapters 4–5 — Finish the story
stages.focus: Close out all five chapters and use the Chapter 4 cafe mission to unlock large bank vault robberies.
stages.detail: Every story trophy is automatic and none can be missed. The optional cafe mission in Chapter 4 is the real prize here: it opens the eight large bank vaults that feed three other trophies. [1][2]

stages.name: The 100% checklist — The long haul
stages.focus: Work the post-story checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion: stunts, ranges, drone races, scans, studies, robberies and 70 of 80 challenges.
stages.detail: The checklist asks for roughly sixty percent of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts and only partial collectible sets. Most activity trophies fall out of this stage on their own. [1][6]

stages.name: Strangers, freaks & character finales
stages.focus: Finish the eight stranger strands that count and close the character questlines that sit outside the 100% checklist.
stages.detail: Only some questlines count as Strangers and Freaks: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy feed their own separate trophies instead. [1][6]

stages.name: Cleanup — Secrets and the platinum
stages.focus: Sweep the one-off secrets, let passive counters finish, then watch A Long Road and the platinum land.
stages.detail: By now only odd jobs remain: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a showroom exit in classic style, and profile actions that should already be in the hundreds. Earn everything else and Vice Got a Price! unlocks last. [1][3]

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, with no extra task of its own [3]. Treat A Long Road as the real final boss, because 100% completion is the requirement that decides when this one can land [1][2].
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies on this list first; the platinum has no separate unlock condition [3].
Keep A Long Road for last, since its 100% checklist absorbs most other progress [1].
Check the tracker after every session so no single bronze is left hiding [2].
When the 54th trophy lands, this one follows automatically [10].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy of the game, awarded for finishing Gone Fishing near the start of Chapter 1 [2]. It is automatic and cannot be missed, so just play the opening at your own pace [1].
steps: Start the story and follow the opening missions in Chapter 1 [1].
Play through the Gone Fishing mission to its end [2].
The trophy unlocks as the mission completes [5].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 1 closes, which happens as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins [1]. Before you let the chapter end, make sure you have accepted Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, because that moment belongs to this chapter [1][6].
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order [1].
Accept the balcony meditation with Lucia when she offers it in the morning [1].
Keep a manual save near the end of the chapter, just in case [1].
Start Chapter 2 and the chapter trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal during Chapter 1, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon [1]. Follow his short questline to the challenge and out-fish him; fishing also feeds your Focus stat, which helps Gunslinger later [9].
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui [1].
Wait for his text and travel to the purple fishing marker [1].
Work through Cal's fishing requests until the challenge starts [6].
Catch more or better fish than Cal before the timer ends [9].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are four arcade video games, and three of them sit on the TV at home from Chapter 1 onward [1]. Finishing every level of any single game earns this; you do not need its optional challenges [1][9].
steps: Interact with the controllers at the TV in Jason's house [1].
Pick one game, such as Tenebrae Lux or Time Jackers Rewind [1].
Play through all of its levels at least once [9].
Finish the final level and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's diving questline starts in Chapter 1 in Key Lento and has you recovering treasure from seven shipwrecks [1]. He goes quiet for a while mid-story but always returns, and every quest stays available after the credits [1][7].
steps: Work for Kenton in Chapter 1 until he marks his shop in Key Lento [1].
Dive the purple treasure markers and return each haul to him [1].
When he goes quiet, continue the story until his text arrives again [1].
Clear all seven shipwrecks and finish his final mission [6].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy in the game that might be missable. One meditation happens at home in Chapter 1, when Lucia walks out to the balcony and offers to teach you; it disappears when the chapter ends and guides disagree on whether the trophy truly needs it, so take it every time [1][6]. SOURCES DISAGREE on the full count: the detailed location guides describe 18 spots across 10 locations, meditated at with both characters [1], while the 100% checklist only demands 15 of them, which is where the lower figure comes from [6]. The final spot also needs Jason and Lucia travelling together, which only opens after Chapter 2 [1].
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen and follow her to the balcony [1].
Choose Accept and complete the home meditation before Chapter 1 ends [1].
From Chapter 2 on, meditate at each marked spot with both Jason and Lucia for double progress [1].
Track the count under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations [6].
Finish the last spot once the pair can travel together and the trophy unlocks [1].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from Chapter 2 [2]. Like every story trophy here it is automatic, unmissable and needs no special preparation [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 2 in the story [1].
Play the Breakfast Run mission when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 2 closes and Chapter 3 begins [1]. Chapter 2 is where the duo unlock happens, so by the time this lands you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together and start the partner trophies [1][9].
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order [1].
Use Coffee Break to unlock travelling together as a pair [1].
Start Chapter 3 and the chapter trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 3 closes, shortly after the opening missions of Chapter 4 [1]. Chapter 3 is dense with unlocks: the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jobs and the laundering system all arrive here, so sweep the side markers before moving on [1][6].
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order [1].
Take Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the Credit Check mission as they appear [1].
Start Chapter 4 and the chapter trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once a Chapter 2 mission marks him on your map [1]. The whole line stays open after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to lose by postponing it [6].
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break so Billy gets marked [1].
Visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County [6].
Complete his five jobs, from Thrillbillies to Hometown Heroes [1].
Finish the final job and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason after Chapter 2 and hands over a specialist hunting rifle for his Target Deck requests [1]. Which exact animal triggers this trophy is still being pinned down by the guides, so work his decks in order and it should land along the way; all 15 decks are needed for 100% anyway [1][6].
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and wait for Bret's text [1].
Meet Bret in Lummox County and take his hunting rifle [1].
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and deliver them as Jason [6].
Keep clearing decks until the unique-animal trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline belongs to Lucia and starts with a phone call during Chapter 3 that marks her home in Belville [1]. Five quests later the line closes; everything remains available after the story if you would rather batch it [1][7].
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and answer Andy's call [1].
Travel to the marked address in Belville [7].
Complete her five quests in order [1].
Finish the final quest and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after a Chapter 3 mission, marking synthetic labs across Vice City with purple icons [1]. Destroy enough labs and his second, final mission unlocks this trophy [1][6].
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty as Jason [1].
Visit the purple Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City [6].
Destroy labs until Tyrone offers his second mission [1].
Complete Spin On This and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun, which opens alarmed back doors silently [1]. Enter through the back, find the safe code, deal with the alarm and the camera footage, and walk out unseen; the trophy pops shortly after you leave [1][6].
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to receive the Snap Gun [1].
Pick a marked jewelry store, such as Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds [6].
Use the Snap Gun on the back door instead of kicking it in [1].
Loot the safe with its code, disable the alarm and wipe the footage [1].
Leave undetected and wait for the unlock [2].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need Jason and Lucia together, which unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [1]. Raise four stars, then break line of sight and clear the red heat zone completely; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the reliable escape route the guides recommend [1][9]. Large bank vault robberies also hand you four stars for free later on [1].
steps: Call your partner so you are travelling as a pair [1].
Cause enough chaos to reach a 4 star wanted level [9].
Break away on a fast bike and head for the Ambrosia train tunnel [1].
Stay hidden until the heat zone clears and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Behind the vague wording sits a stat grind: maximum Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time [1]. Train together at a fitness club, because the partner you bring along completes their own workout automatically and you progress twice as fast [1][9].
steps: Unlock travelling together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [1].
Call your partner before every workout session [1].
Use fitness clubs across Vice City and train until one character maxes Strength [6].
Repeat until the second character also sits at maximum [9].
Check both Strength stats under Jason and Lucia in the pause menu [1].

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Only the eight purchasable garages count, not the four story garages, and together they cost roughly 160,000 dollars [1][6]. They are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app that appears after a Chapter 2 mission, and the space they add is what On the Spot needs [1].
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the real estate app [1].
Earn money through robberies until you hold about 160,000 dollars [6].
Buy each of the eight garages for sale through the phone app [1].
The trophy unlocks when the eighth garage is yours [2].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses installs the Scooter Bros app in Chapter 2, letting you register stolen vehicles for delivery anywhere [1]. Registration needs free garage space, so buy garages first, and use cheap cars and bikes to keep the fees down [1][6].
steps: Meet Moses in Chapter 2 to receive the Scooter Bros app [1].
Buy garages until you have at least ten free spaces [6].
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn [1].
Choose Respray, then Register, for each vehicle [1].
Register the tenth vehicle and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This secret is tied to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, which Chapter 2 marks for you [1]. Steal all three key valuables inside, including the safe you open with sticky bombs, then lose the police; anything you miss respawns later, so it is not missable [1][6].
steps: Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation before you go [1].
Enter Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn during or after its Chapter 2 mission [6].
Take the luxury watch and the unique shotgun from their marked spots [1].
Blow the office safe and loot it [1].
Escape the police and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 mission gives you the Dye Pack Jammer, after which marked bills from banks and payday loans can be sold to fences [1]. It is a running total across all robberies, Yasmani pays the best rate, and a single large vault can contribute most of the target [1][6].
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer [1].
Rob banks and payday loans and keep the marked bills [6].
Deliver the bills to a fence, ideally Yasmani in Vice City [1].
Repeat until the laundered total passes 250,000 dollars [2].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from Chapter 3 [2]. It unlocks as part of the main path and cannot be missed [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 3 in the story [1].
Play The Cartel Heist when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from Chapter 4 [2]. Automatic and unmissable like the rest of the story set [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story [1].
Play Child's Play when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from Chapter 4 [2]. It arrives on the main path and cannot be missed [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story [1].
Play Headliners when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from Chapter 4, set around Vice City International Airport [2][7]. Automatic and unmissable [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story [1].
Play VCIA Takedown when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 4 closes with its final mission, Starting From Zero [1]. Before you finish, consider doing the optional cafe mission in this chapter, because it unlocks the large bank vaults [1][6].
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order [1].
Take the optional cafe mission to unlock bank vault robberies [1].
Finish Starting From Zero and the chapter trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy from the final chapter [2]. Automatic and unmissable [1].
steps: Reach Chapter 5 in the story [1].
Play Operation Savage Glory when it is offered [2].
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks [5].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The second gold on the list, awarded for finishing the final story mission [3][2]. After the credits you keep free-roaming, and the 100% checklist becomes visible, so nothing about finishing the story locks you out of the cleanup [1].
steps: Play through all five chapters [1].
Complete the final mission [2].
After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to start the endgame [1].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Large vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 cafe mission: tail the security van, slip in while the vault is open, and split the cash with your partner [1]. Every vault means an instant four stars, so arrive on a fast bike; you need five for this trophy and all eight for 100% [1][6].
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 cafe mission to unlock vault robberies [1].
Buy van tips from Yasmani and follow a marked security van [1].
Enter the vault while it is open and load both cash bags [6].
Escape the heat zone on a fast motorcycle [1].
Repeat until five vaults are robbed and escaped [2].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 cafe mission earns this automatically, because robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that fed it [1]. Earlier, you can also stop a roaming truck in Vice City and blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb [1][6].
steps: Either wait for the Chapter 4 cafe mission, or find a roaming armored truck [1].
For the early route, block the truck and plant a sticky bomb on its rear doors [1].
Loot the cash once the doors blow [6].
Escape the red heat radius and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies with your partner beside you while the wanted level never drops [1]. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City sit close together and make the cleanest route; bring armor and healing, and expect the unlock to lag about half a minute behind the third shop [1][6].
steps: Call your partner and equip armor, sticky bombs and healing [1].
Rob the first marked shop and keep the wanted level alive [6].
Drive straight to a second shop and rob it without the heat dropping [1].
Rob a third shop the same way, a fourth if the pop is delayed [1].
Keep moving until the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport, not one parked on the open airfield [1]. The planes at terminals E3 and E4 are the easiest: enter via the stairs by the bridge, taxi out, take off and fly about a kilometre away [1][7].
steps: Enter the airfield through a fence and head for terminals E3 or E4 [1].
Use the stairs beside the boarding bridge to enter the docked jet [1].
Go up to the cockpit and taxi the plane to the runway [6].
Take off and fly roughly a kilometre from the airport [1].
The trophy unlocks once you are clear [2].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.scope: Open world — Mile Zero Air Station
trophies.guide: The cryptic wording means stealing a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the south-west edge of the map [1]. The tanks sit at the south of the base; get in, fire on enemies from inside, and the trophy follows [1][7].
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County [7].
Enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance [1].
Climb into a parked tank at the south of the base [1].
Shoot enemies from inside the tank until the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy on the list, and the one the whole roadmap bends around [1]. The checklist only appears after the credits, but progress made during the story already counts, and its demands are lenient: roughly sixty percent of true completion, with partial targets such as 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals [1][6]. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so work it calmly in free-roam [1].
steps: Finish the story so the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion [1].
Scan vehicles and study animals whenever you travel, from the first hour onward [1].
Clear the full-demand blocks: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's decks [6].
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges and 300 stunts for the checklist totals [1].
When the checklist reads 100 percent, the gold unlocks [3].

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixed freely across stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps [1]. Under-bridge runs are the fastest category, and the checklist later wants 300, so every stunt here is banked progress twice over [1][6].
steps: Open the map's Exploration filter to list found stunt spots [1].
Start with under-bridge flights, the quickest category [1].
Mix in stunt jumps and base jumps as you travel between objectives [6].
Track the total in the trophy list and the Progress menu [10].
Reach 250 completed stunts and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: That means gold in all 42 challenges spread across 12 shooting ranges [6]. The guides rate the golds as fair rather than brutal, and range practice also raises Focus, which pays off in Gunslinger [1][9].
steps: Visit the first shooting range and learn its challenge set [6].
Gold one range at a time instead of sampling all twelve [1].
Replay any challenge that lands on silver until it turns gold [9].
Keep count: 42 golds across 12 ranges is the full set [6].
The trophy unlocks with the final gold medal [2].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 drone race locations holding 42 races in total; this trophy needs one win at each location, while 100% wants every race [1][6]. Learn a course with a sighting lap, then push for the win once the gates feel familiar [9].
steps: Find a Top Fun location on the map's activity filter [6].
Win one race at that location [1].
Move to the next location and repeat [6].
After 14 location wins, the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: The word different does the work here: there are 40 races and you must win 20 distinct ones, because repeating a favourite does not add to the count [1][6]. Bring a suitable vehicle for each class and tick races off region by region [9].
steps: Pick an unwon race from the map and note its vehicle class [6].
Win it, then mark it done before choosing the next [1].
Work through new races instead of replaying old wins [1].
Reach 20 different race wins and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types, including fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt [1]. Most players earn this without trying while working the checklist, but the exact nine are worth checking in the Progress menu if yours has not popped [1][9].
steps: Open Progress, Activities, and note which types show zero attempts [1].
Try each missing type once, starting with the ones near you [9].
Use the map's blue activity icons to find the rest [6].
When all nine types show activity, the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are environmental objects you photograph with the phone app: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags [1]. There are more than 100 in the world, so scan whatever crosses your path and this finishes long before the map is empty [1][6].
steps: Open the WAiNK app and learn the scan prompt [1].
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you explore [6].
Check the running total in the Progress collections [10].
Reach 100 scanned locations and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets in the world and this trophy asks for any three completed sets, so focus your hunting on finishing sets rather than scattering single cards everywhere [6]. A few cards sit inside story buildings, but duplicates spawn elsewhere, so no set can be permanently lost [1].
steps: Choose one card set and hunt its cards as a single project [6].
Finish that set completely before starting the next [1].
Complete a second set the same way [6].
Complete a third set and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Hold the WAiNK app up to any vehicle you have not seen and scan it; driving it is not required [1]. A busy roadside spot fills the early count quickly, and since the checklist wants 200 base models, keep scanning all game long [1][9].
steps: Stand somewhere with heavy traffic and open the WAiNK app [1].
Scan every passing model you have not registered yet [9].
Add boats and aircraft whenever you pass marinas and airfields [1].
Reach 100 discovered vehicles and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: You must clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida [1]. A plane is by far the fastest broom: fly slow, overlapping passes over the black patches, including the Keys and the coastline, until nothing stays dark [1][7].
steps: Take a plane once the story gives you easy airfield access [1].
Fly grid passes over every fogged region on the map [7].
Sweep the islands and coastlines that road travel misses [6].
When the whole map is visible, the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations between them; this trophy needs one robbed operation per gang, while 100% eventually wants all 39 [1][6]. Track coverage per gang under Progress, Gangs, so you spread your hits instead of farming one crew [1].
steps: Find a yellow gang operation marker on the map [6].
Rob the operation and note which gang it belonged to [1].
Check Progress, Gangs, to see which gangs are still untouched [1].
Rob one operation for each of the nine gangs [7].
The trophy unlocks when every gang has been hit once [2].

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges and this trophy needs 50, while the checklist later demands 70, so this one normally unlocks on the road to A Long Road [1]. Leave it late: by cleanup time most challenges will already be done passively, and you can cherry-pick the easiest remainders [1][9].
steps: Open Progress, Challenges, and sort by what is already close [1].
Finish challenges that overlap with trophies you are already chasing [9].
Pick off the quickest remaining challenges one by one [6].
Reach 50 completed challenges and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and paints weak spots, but one activation only lasts a few seconds [1]. Prepare properly: raise your Focus level through ranges, golf and fishing, use adrenaline to stretch the window, wear armor, and line up five gang enemies with an assault rifle before you trigger it [1][9].
steps: Raise Focus by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing [1].
Eat, drink or shower to buff Focus, and carry adrenaline [9].
Find five enemies close together at a gang operation [6].
Activate Combat Focus while aiming and drop all five in one use [1].
If it fails, let Focus refill and retry with a fuller bar [9].

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A pure running total across every shop type in the game [1]. Weapons, vehicle mods and tattoos burn money fastest, and since a platinum run earns far more than this through robberies, it should complete without any deliberate farming [1][6].
steps: Play normally and buy gear as you need it [9].
Push the total with guns, mods and tattoos when money is plentiful [1].
Check the running spend in your stats if it has not popped [10].
Cross 100,000 dollars spent and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Early lists marked this one unconfirmed, but the method now reported is simple: buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing by the bar [1]. If your first drink does not register, stay in place and finish it fully before trying another spot along the rail [4].
steps: Travel to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach [1].
Order an Apple Martini at the bar [1].
Drink it while standing next to the bar [4].
The trophy unlocks as the drink finishes [2].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Another entry the first lists could not pin down. The reported method is specific: after earning the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee inside the south Vice City showroom and drive it straight out through the window [1]. Other cars do not count, which is why random showroom escapes fail [4].
steps: Earn the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission for Randy [1].
Enter the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City [6].
Clone the key of the blue Banshee on display [1].
Drive it forward and out through the showroom window [1].
Keep driving until the delayed trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The trap in this trophy is the word strangers: many familiar questlines do not count toward it at all [1]. Confirmed strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm work, Yago's street racing and Pilot Pete's deliveries, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy feed their own trophies instead; more strands are still being discovered, which is why this atlas flags it [1][6].
steps: Start Kirk's strand by searching for the Skunk Ape [1].
Complete Kyle's farm strand and Yago's racing strand [1].
Fly Pilot Pete's delivery strand to completion [6].
Watch the trophy tracker to confirm each strand registered [10].
Finish eight counting strands and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List asks for 16 named sports cars, starting with the Zorrusso you deliver during his Chapter 3 story mission [1]. He marks some cars himself, and the rest cluster around the hotels of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach; deliver them intact for the best pay [1][6].
steps: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy in Chapter 3 to open the Wish List [1].
Check the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List [1].
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to spot wishlist models [9].
Deliver each car to Randy's garage in the west of Vice City [6].
Deliver the sixteenth car and finish his final mission [2].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: You need 500 actions that shift your criminal profile, in any direction: clean robberies, limb shots, kills and worse all register [1]. Turn on the profile notifications in the UI settings so you can see the counter move, and steer away from the Irredeemable tier, which is permanent and makes police far more aggressive [1][9]. Most players finish this passively during the checklist [1].
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications [1].
Play robberies and encounters normally and watch the demon icon appear [9].
Check progress by opening this trophy in the PSN trophy list [10].
Avoid sustained extreme violence so you never lock into Irredeemable [1].
Reach 500 profile actions and the trophy unlocks [2].

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The one secret no guide has cracked yet: the leading belief links it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue and to failing, then succeeding, at the same attempt [1]. Until a method is confirmed, this atlas marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing steps; keep a prologue-era save so you can experiment cheaply when the answer lands [4][5].
steps: Keep a manual save from the prologue before experimenting [1].
Revisit the Payday Loans location tied to the opening [4].
Try the fail-then-retry pattern the description hints at [5].
Watch the tracker and community lists for a confirmed method [2].

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Early lists left this blank, but the reported trigger is a UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, approached solo [1]. The blinking car does not always spawn, so leave and return until it appears, then follow the path into the woods [1][7].
steps: Travel alone at night to the road north-west of Starlet Motel [1].
Look for the blinking car after 2 AM; re-approach if it is absent [1].
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light [7].
Speak with the woman the UFO drops and walk her back to her car [1].
The trophy unlocks as you help her [2].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Another secret the first lists flagged as unknown. The method now reported: ride a motorcycle or bicycle through a crowded area and kick ten pedestrians within sixty seconds using the melee button [1]. Ocean Beach at busy hours gives you the density; expect your criminal profile to notice, so do it when a wanted level costs you nothing [9].
steps: Take a motorcycle or push bike to a crowded area such as Ocean Beach [1].
Ride at moderate speed so the melee kick stays available [9].
Kick ten pedestrians inside a single sixty-second window [1].
Ride clear of the area and the trophy unlocks [2].
